title: Chapter 1115
text:
There seems to be an activity. There is a post in the book review and comment section. Those who are interested can take a look.

Super Godly Mechanic First Book Review Activity

Activity Duration: From now until December 20th, 2019.

Activity Location: Starting Point Book Review Page of "Super Godly Mechanic".

Activity Requirement: Fans of "Super Godly Mechanic" are greater than or equal to apprentices. Otherwise, it will not be valid.

The Super Godly Mechanic First Book Review Page Book Review Competition is as follows:

Participants, please use your wisdom to praise your favorite character. It can be the main character or a supporting character. There is no limit to the content, the number of words, and the style (Participants, please use your own smart and brave imagination to participate enthusiastically).

The title of the entry for this activity must be "Entry for the First Super Godly Mechanic Book Review Competition". Otherwise, it will not be valid.

The rewards for this activity are as follows:

First Place: Reward 50000 Qidian coins (You are the best boss)

Second Place: Reward 30000 Qidian coins (One person under you)

Third Place: Reward 20000 Qidian coins (Very impressive)

Fourth Place: Reward 15000 Qidian coins (Not bad)

Fifth Place: Reward 10000 Qidian coins (Not bad)

Sixth Place to Tenth Place: Reward 5000 Qidian coins

Eleventh Place to Twentieth Place: Reward 2000 Qidian coins

Twentieth Place to Thirtieth Place (Consolation Prize): Reward 1000 Qidian coins (Consolation Prize is not bad either (*???) (*? `)?)

In addition, there will be a Best Idiot Book Review Award, and the winner will be rewarded 5000 Qidian coins (Idiots can also win awards).

(You can register for this activity multiple times, but each account can only win once per month.)

The final explanation rights will belong to the (Super Godly Mechanic) officials.

PS: Speaking of which, if the number of participants is less than the number of awards, then wouldn't it be a waste =???? (???*)
